Digital marketing

What is local SEO?

Local search helps customers discover a business that serves their area. A useful listing lets someone decide whether to call, visit or ask for a quote.

In this guide
Start with what a customer needsConnect the listing to the right pageMeasure useful actions

Start with what a customer needs

Check your business name, main category, phone, opening hours and service area. Use your actual trading details. A clinic open on Saturday should make that easy to confirm on both its website and its Google Business Profile.

Connect the listing to the right page

A customer looking for a particular branch needs that branch’s address and contact details. Give each genuine location a page with helpful information about its services, access and hours. Explain which areas a mobile service covers.

Measure useful actions

Look at calls, direction requests, relevant search terms and completed enquiries together. Ask new customers how they found you. If people visit a page but struggle to contact you, check the mobile call button yourself.
